Simondo's description starting with the words "Simondo says" may be a reference to the popular children's game
, where the person ("Simon") says what the others must do, always starting with the words "Simon Says". It is more likely that this is a coincidence, however.
Simondo's inclusion in Contra's DLC may have been foreshadowing to the fact that the next Vampire Survivors DLC release would be Ode to Castlevania, Castlevania's the game series where
hails, being the character Simondo parodies. The fact that his theme from Hard Corps, Simon 1994RD, a remix of Vampire Killer, was excluded could be considered a clue.
Simondo's based on the likeness of prolific Japanese singer Masato Shimon, with his single 'Swim, Taiyaki-kun!' serving as the basis of his projectile attack in Hard Corps. His code in the
is 'honouringmasato' in reference to that. As it happens, Shimon sang the theme song for Konami arcade game Monster Maulers, known as Kyuukyoku Sentai Dadandarn (究極戦隊ダダンダーン) in Japan.
